description: Labor rights NGO report documented excessive mandatory overtime (up to 80 hrs/week during peak season) and withheld wages for approximately 200 workers at the Savar facility.
Former workers filed a labor board complaint alleging unpaid overtime wages for the September-December 2024 production cycle.
Investigative journalism report alleged use of underage labor at an artisanal mining site feeding into the supplier's cobalt aggregation network in Lualaba Province.
resolution_notes: Third-party audit commissioned; site access restricted pending outcome.

description: Tunnel collapse at an affiliated artisanal mining site resulted in 3 fatalities. Supplier's traceability of ore origin for this shipment could not be confirmed.
source: DRC Ministry of Mines incident report

description: Electrical fire in the SMT line building caused a 6-day production halt. No injuries reported. Root cause traced to overloaded circuit panel.
resolution_notes: Electrical systems upgraded and re-inspected; corrective action verified by third-party auditor in October 2023.

description: Seasonal harvest workers reported passport confiscation and debt bondage practices by a labor recruitment agency contracted by the supplier.
resolution_notes: Supplier disputes findings; independent grievance mechanism review in progress.

description: Structural crack discovered in the Ashulia facility's east wing following a factory inspection; building partially evacuated. Similar to warning signs preceding prior regional factory collapses.
resolution_notes: Partial closure ordered by Accord Foundation pending structural remediation.

description: Audit found underage worker (age 15) employed in the finishing department using falsified identification documents.
resolution_notes: Worker removed from site per remediation protocol, family income support provided, age verification process overhauled.

description: Tailings pond overflow released an estimated 400 cubic meters of process water into a seasonal creek bed near the Antofagasta site.
source: Chilean Superintendency of the Environment (SMA) filing
resolution_notes: Containment completed within 48 hours; SMA fine paid; remediation plan approved March 2025.

description: Recruitment records reviewed during an unannounced audit showed workers transferred through a regional labor transfer program associated with elevated forced-labor risk under UFLPA guidance.
Workers reported delayed payroll (up to 6 weeks late) on three occasions over the past year; no formal grievance mechanism in place at the facility.
source: Site visit notes from procurement team

description: Local news reporting linked a company director to an undisclosed bribery investigation involving customs officials over metals export documentation.
One-day work stoppage over cafeteria conditions; resolved same day after facility management met with worker representatives.
resolution_notes: Cafeteria vendor replaced within two weeks.
